subject: Request: Blended onramp concession — SpectrumWorks POC (credits + discount)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@spectrumworks.io>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Nguyen <cnguyen@spectrumworks.io>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 11:14:00 -0500
Subject: SpectrumWorks POC — ask for blended concession

Hi Hiro,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the Redwood runtime looks promising for our retrieval + summarization flows. We discussed an initial POC to validate latency and cost assumptions and SpectrumWorks is prepared to go live with a 6-week evaluation.

Two asks from my side before legal/finance sign-off:
- Can Redwood provide a $12k credit pool we can draw against token usage for the POC?
- We also need a short-term committed discount on host pricing (20% off list) for any usage over the credit to hit our internal ROI targets.

These combined concessions would let us accelerate procurement and sign the SOW this week. I attached a one-page scope and the list of integration milestones.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you prefer.

Samir Patel
Head of Product
SpectrumWorks
Attachments: spectrum_poc_mvp_scope.pdf (application/pdf)
From: hiro_tanaka@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 08:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: SpectrumWorks POC — ask for blended concession

Marissa / Laura,

Forwarding Samir's ask — small enterprise prospect, strongly product-led, will likely convert to a paid account quickly if POC validates. Key points: $12k credit + a 20% short-term discount on overage pricing. They need procurement paperwork this week.

My read: credits are fine from our POC incentives budget; the discount is a material price concession but could be limited to 30 days post-credit or tied to a small monthly commit. Proposal below I think is conservative and keeps upside:

- $12,000 credit applied to token usage during the 6-week POC.
- 20% discount on paid usage for up to 30 days after credit exhaustion OR until go-live, whichever comes first.
- SpectrumWorks to sign a 3-month minimum post-POC commitment at our standard mid-market rate (or pre-agreed uplift).

Requesting exec-level approval for the blended concession (credits + short discount) and permission to sign SOW with these conditions. If you prefer, I can loop legal for a short amendment.

Thanks,
Hiro Tanaka
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0174
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SpectrumWorks POC — ask for blended concession

Hiro, Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. A few commercial notes after reviewing the scope and HubSpot record:
- Pipeline quality: mid-enterprise, clear technical fit, timing is tight (procurement wants a contract this week).
- ARR upside: forecasted $95k ARR in 12 months if they convert.
- Risk: if we give a discount that persists beyond POC, we set a precedent for similar accounts in this segment.

Recommended guardrails to approve at the leadership level:
1) Approve $12k credit from POC budget.
2) Approve a one-time 20% discount on overage for up to 30 days post-credit. Discount must be hard-coded and sunset automatically in billing; no open-ended rate card changes.
3) Require procurement to sign a 3-month minimal paid commitment at standard list rates after the discount window. Include a clause that the discount does not apply to any future reserved/dedicated pricing.

If Marissa is comfortable, authorizing this here will let Hiro finalize the SOW and attach the redlined doc.

Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@spectrumworks.io>, Claire Nguyen <cnguyen@spectrumworks.io>, procure@spectrumworks.io
Date: Wed, 22 Nov 2028 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SpectrumWorks POC — ask for blended concession

Hiro / Laura / Samir —

Approved with conditions — thanks for the clear guardrails. Executive sign-off on the blended concession (credits + temporary discount) is granted provided Redwood legal inserts both the sunset language and a conversion commitment clause. To be explicit:

- $12,000 promotional credit to apply during the 6-week POC only.
- 20% overage discount limited to the first 30 days after the credit is exhausted, automatic sunset; billing team to implement the discount flag so it cannot be re-applied.
- SpectrumWorks must sign a 3-month minimum paid commitment that begins at the end of the discount window (or on conversion) at standard mid-market rates; early termination clauses acceptable but no retroactive discounts.
- Final approval conditioned on receipt of agreement_redline_v2.docx with legal's standard language added (copy in thread).

Hiro — you're cleared to finalize the SOW and send to Samir with the redline attached. Laura — please confirm POC budget charge code and that credits will be applied correctly. Finance will need the HubSpot deal id referenced in this thread.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-650-555-0219
Attachments: agreement_redline_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
